Three.js 0.169.0 (MIT)
Source: https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/tree/r169
Downloaded from the version-pinned npm package via https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.169.0/

Included: three.module.js, OrbitControls.js, GLTFLoader.js, OBJLoader.js,
STLLoader.js, utils/BufferGeometryUtils.js, THREE-LICENSE.txt.

GLTFLoader.js has one relative import adjusted to ./utils/BufferGeometryUtils.js
because this project's vendor directory keeps loaders at its root.
OrbitControls.js captures only trusted pointer events and releases only captured
pointers so WaveBoard's synthetic camera input adapter can orbit models.
All other files are unmodified upstream source. No internet is needed at runtime.

The host page must define the import map before importing viewer3d.js:
{"imports":{"three":"./vendor/three.module.js"}}
